entries.f6ea82b4987d3e9f: The long-term vision 'Machi no Akari Vision 2035,' announced in October 2025, is based on the corporate philosophy of creating high-quality medical infrastructure and watching over people throughout their lives as a 'town light' that contributes to healthy living. It divides the business into three areas, the medical area, the medical support area and the medical supply area, and targets a support count of 45,000 facilities for the fiscal year ending March 2035. The 7th medium-term management plan based on this vision, covering the fiscal years ending March 2027 to March 2030, positions the first 4 years as a period of structural transformation. It aims to shift to a more profitable portfolio by transforming its business and sales using customer touchpoints and transaction networks as market foundations, and targets a support count of 25,000 facilities for the fiscal year ending March 2030.
